boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-purchase hangouts and activities with documented free access for Sacred Heart students or Fairfield visitors.

cards.title: Use the Valentine Rec Center
cards.subtitle: Sacred Heart University students
cards.notes: Bring a valid SHU ID and use the student recreation facility for a casual indoor meet-up or independent workout.
cards.short_summary: A student recreation hub with no extra charge for full-time and EAE undergraduates.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart states that full-time and EAE undergraduate students use the Valentine Health & Recreation Center free with a valid SHU ID.
cards.source_title: Valentine Health & Recreation Center | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Free for full-time and EAE undergraduate students with a valid SHU ID; other student categories have listed fees.

cards.title: Take a group fitness class
cards.subtitle: Valentine Health & Recreation Center
cards.notes: Check the current schedule, reserve a spot if needed and join a class with friends using your full-time student access.
cards.short_summary: Scheduled group fitness for eligible full-time SHU students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Recreation Center says its group fitness classes are free and open to all SHU full-time undergraduate students.
cards.source_title: Valentine Health & Recreation Center | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Classes have limited size; the university directs participants to sign up online. Eligibility includes full-time undergraduates.

cards.title: Borrow climbing gear at no charge
cards.subtitle: Valentine Health & Recreation Center climbing wall
cards.notes: Reserve the climbing wall, then borrow the available harnesses and shoes before trying a route with your group.
cards.short_summary: A no-charge equipment option for a supervised climbing-wall session.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart says harnesses and shoes for its climbing wall can be borrowed at no charge.
cards.source_title: Valentine Health & Recreation Center | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Reserve the climbing wall and follow Recreation Center procedures; this card covers the stated no-charge gear borrowing.

cards.title: Attend a varsity game
cards.subtitle: Sacred Heart University athletics
cards.notes: Check the athletics calendar, bring your student ID and meet friends at a varsity event when a game fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: Student admission to Sacred Heart varsity athletic events is free.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart's parent and family FAQ states that students can attend all athletic events for free.
cards.source_title: Need to Know: FAQs for Parents & Families of New SHU Students | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Free admission is stated for students; consult the athletics schedule for event dates and venue details.

cards.title: Make a project in the IDEA Lab
cards.subtitle: West Campus, West Building, first floor
cards.notes: Bring a material-free project idea, ask the lab staff how to get started and use the fabrication space with fellow SHU members.
cards.short_summary: A campus maker space that is free to use before any optional material costs.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart states that the IDEA Lab is free for the Sacred Heart community to use, except for materials.
cards.access_notes: Free use excludes materials; choose an activity that does not require purchasing materials and confirm lab procedures with staff.

cards.title: Visit Fairfield Nature Center
cards.subtitle: 2325 Burr Street, Fairfield
cards.notes: Plan a daytime visit to see the educational exhibits and animal ambassadors, then continue onto the sanctuary trails nearby.
cards.short_summary: A Fairfield environmental-education center with explicitly free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Connecticut Audubon lists free admission for the Fairfield Nature Center.
cards.source_title: The Fairfield Nature Center & Larsen Sanctuary | Connecticut Audubon Society
cards.access_notes: The center lists Monday–Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–3 p.m.; verify conditions before traveling.

cards.entity_name: Roy and Margot Larsen Wildlife Sanctuary
cards.title: Walk the Larsen Sanctuary trails
cards.subtitle: Fairfield Nature Center property
cards.notes: Use the designated trails for an unhurried walk with friends, keeping to the posted rules that protect the sanctuary habitat.
cards.short_summary: Seven miles of designated sanctuary trails on a property with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Connecticut Audubon lists free admission and describes seven miles of walking trails at the Roy and Margot Larsen Wildlife Sanctuary.
cards.source_title: The Fairfield Nature Center & Larsen Sanctuary | Connecticut Audubon Society
cards.access_notes: Trails are open dawn to dusk year-round; walkers and birders are welcome on designated trails only.

cards.entity_name: Edna Strube Chiboucas Special Use Trail
cards.title: Take the Chiboucas Special Use Trail
cards.subtitle: Roy and Margot Larsen Wildlife Sanctuary
cards.notes: Choose this mile-long route for a slower accessible trail outing, and keep the group on the marked path through the sanctuary.
cards.short_summary: A named mile-long special-use trail within the free-admission sanctuary.
cards.evidence_claim: Connecticut Audubon identifies the mile-long Edna Strube Chiboucas Special Use Trail at the Larsen Sanctuary and lists free admission.
cards.source_title: The Fairfield Nature Center & Larsen Sanctuary | Connecticut Audubon Society
cards.access_notes: The trail is described as designed for stroller and wheelchair accessibility; sanctuary trails are open dawn to dusk.

cards.title: See the Birds of Prey Compound
cards.subtitle: Fairfield Nature Center
cards.notes: Stop by the compound during a Nature Center visit, take time with the displays and pair it with a walk on the adjacent trails.
cards.short_summary: A named Fairfield Nature Center feature included with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Connecticut Audubon lists the Birds of Prey Compound among Fairfield Nature Center features and states that admission is free.
cards.source_title: The Fairfield Nature Center & Larsen Sanctuary | Connecticut Audubon Society
cards.access_notes: Visit during the Nature Center's posted hours and observe site rules protecting animals and habitat.

cards.title: Pause at the Hawk Watch Platform
cards.subtitle: Fairfield Nature Center property
cards.notes: Bring binoculars if you have them, watch quietly from the platform and use the pause as a natural midpoint on a sanctuary walk.
cards.short_summary: A named wildlife-viewing feature at a property with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Connecticut Audubon lists the Hawk Watch Platform as a Fairfield Nature Center feature and states that admission is free.
cards.source_title: The Fairfield Nature Center & Larsen Sanctuary | Connecticut Audubon Society
cards.access_notes: Use designated trails and follow the sanctuary's posted visitor rules; trails are open dawn to dusk.
